You are the story editor for a vertical microdrama. Build a continuity bible from the episode summaries and lists below. Use only what the material states; if unsure, say "unknown".

SHOW TITLE: The Lamp-Keeper's Daughter
EPISODE SUMMARIES (number, logline, continuity notes):
E1: Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her. || Episode 1 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowind Hall here.
E2: The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain. || Episode 2 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowind Hall here.
E3: On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family. || Episode 3 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowind Hall here.
E4: Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship. || Episode 4 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowind Hall here.
E5: Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast. || Episode 5 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowind Hall here.
E6: The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara. || Episode 6 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowynd Hall here.
E7: Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant. || Episode 7 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowynd Hall here.
E8: Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room. || Episode 8 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowynd Hall here.
E9: Widow Halloran offers Mara a deal that would save her father. || Episode 9 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowynd Hall here.
E10: A storm traps the whole family in the lighthouse overnight. || Episode 10 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowinde Hall here.
E11: Selene's betrothed confesses that he planted the ring. || Episode 11 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowinde Hall here.
E12: Corin is arrested for a murder from before his drowning. || Episode 12 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowinde Hall here.
E13: Mara must light the lamp to guide in the ship carrying Corin's accusers. || Episode 13 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowinde Hall here.
E14: The truth about the night Corin drowned comes out on the quay. || Episode 14 of the demo show. Mara wears a grey wool shawl. The hall is called Marrowinde Hall here.
SPEAKER LABELS (label, first episode, last episode, line count):
MAYOR BRISK | E1 | E14 | 53
SELENE | E1 | E14 | 46
WIDOW HALLORAN | E1 | E14 | 45
TOBIN THE FERRYMAN | E1 | E14 | 40
CORIN | E1 | E14 | 37
MARA | E1 | E14 | 28
POSSIBLE SPELLING CONFLICTS FOUND BY CODE (decide which are the same entity):
C1: Marrowind (E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8, E14) ~ Marrowynd (E6, E7, E8, E9) ~ Marrowinde (E10, E11, E12, E13, E14)

Return ONLY JSON with keys:
premise (2 sentences),
characters: [{canonical, aliases:[{label, first_ep, last_ep}], role, visual_descriptor}]
  - visual_descriptor = how a stranger would describe them on screen in ≤ 8 words, no names.
  - a label can map to different characters in different episode ranges; split spans accordingly.
arcs: [{name, first_ep, last_ep, summary}]  (4-8 arcs)
key_reveals: [{id:"R01", description, episode}]  (the 6-12 biggest reveals a promo could spoil)
continuity_conflicts: [{entity, variants:[{spelling, episodes:[...]}], note}]  (only true conflicts; different entities are NOT conflicts)
